# research-software-identity-audit

A research software and study infrastructure for preregistered longitudinal auditing of research software identity propagation across open scholarly infrastructures, with explicit contracts, provenance, evidence, schemas, and reproducible observations

### DOI:

# research-software-identity-audit

> Research infrastructure for a prospective longitudinal audit of research software identity propagation across open scholarly infrastructures.

This repository is the operational, evidence, provenance, and reproducibility workspace for the study:

Longitudinal Audit of Research Software Identity Propagation Across Open Scholarly Infrastructures

The study is publicly preregistered on OSF and examines how a fixed corpus of research software objects is represented, propagated, preserved, aggregated, discovered, corrected, or left unresolved across multiple scholarly-infrastructure layers over time.

> Important: This repository supports the study. It is not an eleventh research-software object in the fixed ten-object study corpus.

Agentic Research Constellation | Research Software Directory

# Agentic Research Constellation

Ten independent research-software objects connected through evidence, provenance, reproducibility, scientific communication, and longitudinal observation

Agentic Research Constellation is a project-level representation of ten independent research-software objects developed and maintained as a connected research system Each software object retains its own repository, version history, scholarly identifier, archival lineage, technical scope, and research identity The project does not collapse these objects into a single software package or analytical unit. Instead, it provides a shared organizational layer connecting work across agent systems, reproducible research infrastructure, evidence engineering, scientific communication, observatories, and persistent scholarly workflows The constellation is organized around evidence, provenance, reproducibility, scientific communication, and longitudinal observation, while preserving the independent identity and history of every software object
